resolution: Found the multi-second gap the stopwatch caught and the probes missed (dd1445d9f). mapBuildFootprints — the 2D map's building-footprint grouping — runs on EVERY shell render (index.tsx:600, unmemoized), and for non-prefab pieces its grouping did an O(N) pieces.find PER MEMBER ID: one big connected building at ~4.9k pieces = millions of string-compare scans, re-run on every render, fired again right after every move. It is now WeakMap-cached on the pieces array identity (computed once per actual world change; an id Map kills the nested find) and prints [PLACEFREEZE] mapFootprints when a real pass exceeds a frame. Also closed the measurement holes: moves now stamp the release-to-standing probe (only paint had it) so a move prints '[DRAGDRAW] move commit (N pieces) -> standing ms=..'; liftToTerrain is probed; and a frame-stall watchdog in the iso pane prints '[DRAGDRAW] frame stall ms=..' for ANY >150ms main-thread gap — so whatever time remains will name itself instead of hiding. game verify GREEN 72/72. Repro: move the same building, stopwatch it, and paste the lines — expect the stall to be mostly gone, and any leftover to show as a named stall line.
